- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods; reduce forecast peaks when sentiment is high or recently positive.
- Underestimate prices during strong negative sentiment; adjust downward only if sentiment is persistently negative or trending down.
- Avoid overreacting to recent spikes; cap forecast overshoots by 10–15% above recent high if sentiment is neutral or cooling.
- Mean-revert forecasts toward recent 7–14 day average if sentiment is mixed or trending sideways.
- Lag correction: if sentiment is rising, delay forecast peak by 1–2 days; if sentiment is falling, anticipate early dip and adjust downward.
- For 30-day horizon, reduce forecast volatility if sentiment is low or flat; increase smoothing if sentiment is volatile or polarized.
